title: OpenAI Launches Decisions API That Is 10x Faster Than GPT-6 Luna
summary:
Developers can now integrate a new routing tool from OpenAI into their applications to select specific models, tools, or actions in near real-time. The Decisions API is currently in public beta and delivers a speed increase of up to 10x compared to accessing GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API, focusing on the high volume of minor operational choices required for app responsiveness.

OpenAI plans to implement the tool internally to enhance the user experience across its own products. The system functions as a realtime general classifier, which the company states will create new possibilities for application design and efficiency.
